Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:22:00 +0100
Subject: Duplicate charge on Feb invoice?

Hi Alex,

We reviewed our February statement and noticed two identical line items for the 14-day trial conversion for project 'EdgeMesh' (invoice #RH-2026-02-04). Each charge is €2,280; the invoice shows them both as 'Trial conversion - standard'. We only expected one conversion charge for the single project.

Attached is an export from our billing system showing both line items and our internal PO. Can you confirm whether Redwood queued the conversion twice and what the remediation path is? We are an EU VAT-registered business (VAT ID IT123456789). If a refund is required, please advise the documentation you need for VAT reconciliation.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance | ClearHarbor Tech
elena@clearharbortech.com

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this and for the CSV. I’m very sorry for the disruption. I’ve opened a remediation ticket with finance and CS and looped Laura and Marissa to confirm the fastest path (credit note vs refund) and VAT handling for your case.

Quick asks so we can move fast:
- Can you confirm the exact legal entity name and full VAT number to appear on the credit note (you listed IT123456789 — please confirm if that should read IT12345678901).
- Would you prefer a netted account credit applied to your next invoice, or a direct refund to the card/bank we used for the charge? We can do either; for EU VAT reconciliation customers often prefer a credit note so their receivable reconciles cleanly.

Plan: we will propose a remediation that preserves VAT auditability (credit note with VAT adjustment) and, pending your confirmation, issue either a single credit for €2,280 or a combined credit of €4,560 (to reverse both charges). I’ll share a drafted credit note and a proposed schedule within 48 hours.

Apologies again — I’ll follow up shortly with the agreed path.

Best,
Alex Martinez

Subject: Resolution plan: duplicate trial charge (invoice RH-2026-02-04) — proposed credit note CN-2026-045

Hi Elena / Marco — thank you again for raising this. Here’s the remediation proposal from Redwood:

Summary
- Incident: Duplicate 'Trial conversion - standard' line posted twice for EdgeMesh on invoice RH-2026-02-04 (two line items of €2,280 each).
- Total to remediate: €4,560 (gross).

Proposed remediation (recommended)
1) Credit note: Issue CN-2026-045 for €4,560 (gross). VAT treatment: zero-rated credit citing your provided EU VAT ID (IT123456789). Finance will include a reverse-charge note in the ledger for audit. Credit note PDF attached.
2) Posting: Full ledger credit will be applied immediately upon issuance; credit will appear on your Redwood portal within 48–72 hours.
3) Goodwill: Redwood will add 10 hours of complimentary support (valid 90 days) to offset the operational impact; Marissa will send scheduling options.
4) Refund option: If you prefer a direct refund instead of an account credit, we can process a wire once we receive IBAN + proof of bank account. Note: for cash refund we will still issue a credit note (to keep VAT audit consistency) and finance will execute the refund net of VAT per local law.

Next steps (action items)
- Please confirm the legal entity and exact VAT ID to appear on the credit note (we currently have IT123456789).
- Confirm whether you want the amount as an account credit or a refund to the card/bank. If refund, please provide IBAN and the name on the account.
- Once you confirm, we will finalize CN-2026-045 and issue it within 24 hours.

Attachments: credit_note_draft_CN-2026-045.pdf, proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx

We appreciate your patience — apologies for the mistake. Please reply with the VAT confirmation and preferred remediation path and we’ll take it from there.

Best regards,
